lines.text: Shimei keeps cursing and flinging dust from the valley of Elah, and David's company arrives exhausted and refreshes there.

problems.problem: It has 21 words. Each line is 20 words or fewer.
Its true detail "along the ridge of the hill opposite David" isn't in 2 Samuel 16:13 word for word.
Its wrong detail "from the Mount of Olives" is 5 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
